title: Put Capabilities in the Model, Keep Boundaries in the System

coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured AI blog redirects to Microsoft Source AI. Neither static nor rendered lists supplied dates. The configured feed returned HTTP 410. The AI topic feed returned ten entries, latest September 10 at 13:08:37 UTC, with none in the window. A separate all-site Source feed returned ten entries spanning October 6 at 22:41:27 to October 9 at 15:44:02 UTC; five AI-related or Surface events in this discovery window were retained as candidates. The alternative feed does not establish equivalent coverage of the configured entry point.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured GitHub blog’s latest page date is September 23, 2025, which cannot establish no updates. The current research page’s rendered first screen shows September 2, 18, and 20, 2026, with none in the calendar window. Pagination and filters were not checked. Page-config data still contains older 2025 dates, and article retrieval returned an empty array. A supplementary Hugging Face organization check found one newly created model in the window, Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, as a lead. GitHub pushes were reference material only; releases were not checked repository by repository. Configuration was unchanged.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The static page returned HTTP 200 with about 127 KB of HTML, its latest date September 16, 2025. Two news links lacked nearby paired titles and publication dates. The rendered DOM yielded no dated news cards. This does not establish an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: API update dates were July 24 and 31, August 13 and 21, and September 10, 2026. English and Chinese news pages included September 29 and December 1, 2025, and April 24 and September 10, 2026. Harness page dates were August 12 and September 1 and 4, 2026. A Next.js render timestamp of October 8 was excluded from publication dates. No calendar-window dates were found in these page lists. Among 44 organization repositories, two had window pushes and none were newly created. Checking releases for the two repositories with pushes found one window release candidate. Commits are not announcements; the wider release scope remains incomplete.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: Configured news paths returned HTTP 200 after a retry for an initial SSL EOF on the Chinese path. News dates most recently showed September 10, 2026, and research dates August 26. None fell in the calendar window. Article bodies were not read, and model-navigation dates were not treated as publication dates.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The static response was a roughly 2 KB frontend shell. Rendering showed Step 5 Preview, Step 3.7 Flash, Step 3.5 Flash, and StepAudio 3, with a four-day open-source countdown. Earlier receipts showed six days on October 8 and four on October 10; the current countdown has not advanced with the date, and its target may have changed. It is not a publication date. There was no absolute release date or separate news stream, and no dated window items were found. This does not establish an absence of updates.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: The static homepage showed announcements dated February 13, March 23, and September 24, 2026. Active-venue and open-submission lists lacked individual submission times. New submissions were not filtered across venues. Homepage reachability does not mean there were no new papers.
coverage_gaps.36氪 AI 频道（逐篇核验原创与转载）: The channel supplied 30 server-rendered entries plus seven load-more API pages, 240 entries in total, spanning October 10 at 21:52:58.636 to October 3 at 15:03:38 Beijing time and crossing the discovery-window start. Of 216 window entries, article-level publication times, sourceType, userType, bylines, and opening/closing attributions identified 212 contributions and four 36Kr originals. Their complete bodies were not read.
coverage_gaps.国家网信办·网信发布（AI 相关）: The first news-list page contained twenty entries with dated URL paths, spanning September 23 to July 24. No calendar-window entries or AI-related window titles were retained; other titles were recorded as excluded hits. Article bodies were not opened.
coverage_gaps.Ars Technica: The first AI page had 36 datetime elements, spanning October 9 at 18:04:07 to September 28 at 12:43:18 (UTC−4), crossing the discovery-window start. Six entries fell in the window. Bodies were not read, and original versus syndicated FT or WIRED attribution was not determined.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review: Rendering the configured topic page produced twelve article links with URL dates from October 9 back to January 12. The official topic feed’s ten entries spanned October 9 at 09:00 UTC to October 2 at 08:00 UTC; four were in the window. No additional window-date links outside the feed were found; URL dates alone lacked paired titles. Four candidates were discovered, without reading their full bodies.
coverage_gaps.404 Media: The homepage and pages two and three paired title links with datetime values. Nine entries fell in the calendar window, and the oldest visible date, September 26, crossed the start boundary. Full bodies were not read; entries were not deleted through an AI-only filter.
